615.synopsis: A genius magician, to fight against his fate to die a natural death from old age, grasped at the truth of magic to allow himself to reincarnate with a power he created himself. The cycle of reincarnation is repeated multiple times and in his 31st reincarnation, the magician became a boy named Syril who lives in a village of elves. However, that village is ruled by Humans, and the Elves are treated as livestock. After becoming 14 years old, Syril, who regained his past knowledge and experience, stands up to help a girl, who is his childhood friend. The story of the creation of an ideal country begins in that one village, a place where all races can coexist. Elves, Fox-girl, and various other Heroines.

2151.synopsis:
This is an era where demons run rampant. The brave maiden has embarked on her journey…
It is said that a wife can be bought with money; then a husband can also be purchased. Xin Mei has nothing but money. She wants to buy herself a good-looking and useful husband…

3175.synopsis:
It was in the year 2800 of the Midgard calendar. Back then, there was a Overlord who once reigned supreme and had reached the very brink of subduing the world.
Her name was Ruphas Mafahl, a great woman dreaded as the Black-Winged Overlord.
She was too strong, too fast, and too beautiful…
However, she was defeated by Heroes who opposed her ferocity, and her ambition was brought to an end.
――or so went the story of our protagonist’s in-game character, whose body he now possesses for some reason in a world 200 years after Ruphas’ downfall. Follow our protagonist as he becomes unnecessarily feared by his surroundings and unnecessarily worshiped by his former subordinates as he―or now she―cheerfully travels around this fantasy world.

4455.synopsis:

4711.synopsis:

The main character, Liu Gan, is a quadruple amputee in real life. A quirk in the server code recognized his prosthetic limbs as ‘real limbs’ in game, giving him ‘normal’ arms and legs that nonetheless have the strength and power of steel limbs, and thus far more power than a normal player. With this minor cheat helping him survive the early stages of the game, Liu Gan sets out to find out what exactly is going on, and to endure as long as he can.

A man’s soul went back to his former life to face the darkness and survive.

And as Celestials they have to overcome seven celestial divinities, Genesis, Enlighten, Emotion, Transverse, Seventh Sense, Crisis and Ascend in order to transcend to the Heavens.”
When Jiang Le falls down a cliff, he was not prepared for what is to come and discovered that he had found a secret celestial clan and that the martial fraternity that he had always believe it to be is not what it is!

18279.synopsis:

After a short time, a rumor from the demons spread to heaven that Luo Qianhua could not bear the Demon King’s torture and committed su*cide by jumping from the highest spirit extermination stage and vanished. A thousand years later, a little hedgehog elf appeared on an isolated island in the far eastern sea, who looked like Luo Qianhua. Is she his sacrificed fiancée? Can the emperor win her back?

29031.synopsis:
Azalea, the Duke’s daughter, had the misfortune of remembering her previous life. It was a pathetic and tragic life where she was executed for throwing the country into chaos by seducing the emperor of the time. In her final moments before being executed, as she was falsely accused of evil acts and with her family and everyone close to her having already been killed, she decided that if she had another chance, she would never be involved with people in powerful positions ever again.
But by some cruel twist of fate, Azalea somehow ended up as the fiancée of Crown Prince Lotus. In her previous life, everything was caused by her beautiful appearance, but that wasn’t even the case anymore!
“I’m sure that someone who is more suitable for His Highness than my pitiful self will come along, so I’ll just gracefully retreat when that time comes,” is what Azalea thought, hoping to live a long and peaceful life this time.

“I love you, too.”

29799.synopsis:
This is a world where the living have become the undead, a world where faith remains unwavering but yet crumbles, a world where everything is available but yet, nothing remains.
We yearn for salvation and hope for a downfall with cold cruelty as we act out with our insanity and zealous nature. We may be as strong as the gods, but we’re also as ignoble as ants…
Stop and you’ll be in hell, but going forward is just the same, only at a different place.

30055.synopsis:
A scientist who lost his wife in an unforeseen accident.
He set out to create a clone of his wife because of loneliness.
But just before the birth of the clone, he was converted and the clone was discarded.
But then for a while. Scientists who are subjected to guilt will receive unexpected punishment.
The runaway of the science which does not stop. The sci-fi short short of two men who are crazy for love, depicting their sins and punishments.

31335.synopsis:
A man who lost his consciousness and opened his eyes in an unknown place on his way home from his part-time job begins a game of survival…
“Yes, please. This damn game.”
Dungeons, survival, hunters, in a new modern fantasy.

32359.synopsis:
“The Hero defeated the Demon King in the war of men against demons…”
Those kinds of stories are a thing of the past. Nowadays, adventurers, demons, Heroes, Demon Kings, and so on are all occupations that no longer involve putting one’s life on the line. Peace has returned to the world, and dungeon exploration has now become a form of entertainment. 
Adventurers and monsters now all fight using clones they’ve created with magic in an extremely popular form of dungeon clearing where nobody dies. The footage of the dungeon getting cleared gets broadcasted all across the continent, and I’m a member of a Hero’s party that was ranked the 4th most popular in the world… but not anymore. Parties had a limitation of 5 members, and I was told that an unpopular job like Black Sorcerer would only get in the way of getting to 3rd place or beyond.
Now that I became unemployed, I was forced to find another party but I just couldn’t find one. One day, I encountered a beautiful blonde red-eyed woman who told me she had a job for me. After being so touched from having someone recognize my abilities far more than my past comrades, I ended up agreeing to take an interview without asking for the details. When I arrived at my destination, I was at the world’s hardest dungeon where no party has ever reached the final area, the Demon King Castle, where the Big Four and the Demon King were waiting for me. 
This is the story of a Black Sorcerer that was kicked out of a Hero’s party and joined the side of the Demon King Army to repel the Heroes.

38759.synopsis: When I tripped into another world, it was a world where there was no black hair. As a rare find, I have been presented to the rear palace as a tribute to the king of a neighboring country. A fast-paced woman tries to survive in the back palace in a world where she doesn’t know the language. It’s a story that moves all at its own pace.

40295.synopsis:
He was hit by a car when he tried to save a girl and was reborn as Lex, the most powerful character in the early stages of the RPG world! He starts off at a staggering level of 50! He’s an all-rounder well equipped with skills from all areas and he’s even good-looking! This was an absolute big win!
Or so one might think… but Lex was actually just a minor character in the early stages, like those early SR cards in online games or the old paladin with the silver spear in SRPGs. Even if you’re very strong at the start, you’d soon become completely useless! 
As I battled with the monsters and went through events I was bound to experience while enduring the poor growth rate, disappointing unique skills, and the status of being a jack of all trades but master of none, I made up my mind—
「I’ll just dump all the troublesome things onto the game’s hero who should be out there somewhere and retire in a quiet place!」
This is the story of an ordinary person looking for a “hero” who somehow ends up becoming the hero who saves the world!

Although her outward appearance is that of a child, she is a mysterious, mythical existence known as a Soul Eater whose “work” permanently engraves itself into her body with each bloody bite she takes. It’s not like I have any power.
If I want to keep this pitiful life, I’ve got to run first and think later.
But, uh… they say the Duke who tried to kill me died instead?
Knock knock. Young Master, it’s me, your runaway maid.
I’ve come back quietly and obediently.
You’ll forgive me… won’t you?

117095.synopsis:
To help her girlfriend escape the zombies’ encirclement, she used her weak body to ere*t a wall, but her girlfriend instead cherished another woman like a treasure, protecting her.
When escaping, she never once looked back at her, not even for a glance.
After rebirth.
Su Wenwen immediately chose to break up, fulfilling her ex’s wish to be with the white moonlight.
Unexpectedly, she was bound to a system, and only then did she realize she was a mere passerby cannon fodder whose name wasn’t even worthy of appearing in the book, while the white moonlight in her ex’s heart turned out to be the strongest villain boss set in the book.
The system tempted her:
Do you want to take revenge on your s*um ex?
Then capture the villain, make her fall in love with you.
Su Wenwen: ……

119399.synopsis:
Wei Yunshu constantly toiled for the Cloud Sect.
Yet, those hypocritical individuals called her the Cloud Sovereign in public, fearing and respecting her, but behind her back, they believed her origins were lowly and that she was unfit to rule.
Some wanted to seize her sovereign position, others to strip her immortal bones, and even her Dao Companion, whom she cherished, valued, loved, and respected, wanted her dead.
This was a marriage she had stubbornly insisted upon in the past, and even the heavens were unwilling to grant her fulfilment.
What was owed, would eventually be repaid.
…
That year, Luo Lingfeng walked out of the Luoshui Divine Palace and became the Cloud Sovereign’s consort.
For her, this was not glory, but endless humiliation.
Her original fiancé tore up their engagement because of this, and her usually gentle father turned ruthless.
In this transaction, no one asked for her opinion.
Later, the Luoshui Palace crumbled.
Then she successfully replaced Wei Yunshu, becoming the true leader of the Cloud Sect.
Finally, she watched Wei Yunshu leap into the Abyssal Vortex, her soul scattered.
She thought she would be overjoyed at having avenged her great hatred, but unexpectedly, her heart turned to ashes.
Wei Yunshu told her not to hate, but if she didn’t hate, where would she find meaning in her existence?
…
Three years after her soul clung to vegetation.
Wei Yunshu walked out of the Abyssal Vortex.
From then on, there was no Cloud Sovereign in the world, only a carefree wanderer named Bo Fengliu, riding a donkey and holding a whisk, traveling across the lands.

124519.synopsis:
Bai Cheng woke up to find herself transformed into a white haired beauty, and she even has a l**bian best friend!
But before she could even celebrate, life threw her another curveball.  
【Welcome to the Infinite Train World. Here, you can recruit employees and build your own train.】  
【Please reach Station One, 500 kilometers away, within five days!】  
Bai Cheng stared at the rusty handcart in front of her, her lips twitching.  
“You expect me to cover 500 kilometers with this piece of junk??”  
Luckily, things aren’t entirely hopeless. Bai Cheng transmigrated with an innate ability that could upgrade items the more she used them.  
【Matchstick → Upgraded to Nuclear Lighter!】  
【Initial Dagger → Upgraded to Fatal Edge!】  
【White Employee Card → Upgraded to Gold Employee Card!】  
While everyone else is struggling to survive and trudging along, Bai Cheng is decked out in golden legendaries.  
“This lady will be a boss in this Train World!”  
“…Wait, why did I say ‘this lady’?”
associated_names: 列车求生：我变身白毛肝帝！

127079.synopsis:
She had thought the servant was just an immature young man until he unwrapped the bandages around his chest in front of her husband and revealed that he was actually a woman.
Even in a loveless political marriage, witnessing her husband commit adultery was wretched beyond words.
“It will only be for a while, so don’t make a fuss. Pretend you know nothing.”
Her mother-in-law had always been consistent.
“Your husband loves me.”
Draped in a beautiful, elegant gown, she acted as though she were the true mistress of the estate, claiming absurdly that she was the heroine of this story.
⬤ ⬤ ⬤ ⬤ ⬤ ⬤
Barnes Hilbardo — the crown prince’s younger brother and second in line to the throne — set his sword down at her feet.
“If you wish it, I will cut off my brother’s head and lay it before you.”
“Your Highness, this is not a matter for you to involve yourself in.”
Vengeance against those who had taken what she cherished most was an entirely personal affair. There was no reason for the prince to interfere.
“The time will come when you need power. When it does, use me as your weapon.”
His icy blue eyes were as beautiful and piercing as the magic of the Winter Queen.
“In return, marry me. That is all I ask.”

146535.synopsis:
I reunited with Ryu Dohyuk, the ex-boyfriend I had dumped, on an idol survival show.
I was a struggling trainee, and he was the host.
“Why are you living like this? You threw away our relationship to debut, so why are you still at rock bottom?”
“…We’re not together anymore. Do I really need to answer that question?”
Despite his earlier glare, Ryu Dohyuk was now being needlessly professional, keeping his personal and professional lives strictly separate.
The confusion was entirely Seha’s burden.
“Does that friend of yours know about us? Or is he just sticking around to mess with me?”
“He’s just a former colleague from my old agency…”
Dohyuk pretended to be indifferent, yet he was clearly concerned about Seha’s interactions with other contestants.
The moment Seha saw the bloodshot veins in Ryu Dohyuk’s eyes, he knew.
“Do you know why I’ve clung so desperately to this industry?”
“……”
“So that I can at least see the face of hyung, who debuted without fear.”
The young beast he had cruelly released…
“But seeing you in someone else’s arms right in front of me… that’s just wrong.”
It felt like that beast had returned as a fully grown predator, ready to sink its teeth into his neck.

147815.synopsis:
Ning Jiu, a skilled surgeon, had just been promoted to Associate Chief at a general hospital. He merely drank some celebratory wine that night, yet he woke up to find himself transformed into the Second Young Master of the Marquis of Jingan’s household.
However, this Second Young Master was born with the cursed fate of the “Lone Star of Heavenly Evil” —a destiny that brings harm and ruin to family and everyone nearby. To make matters worse, he is set to be married off to a man!
His partner is Prince Yan, the man who holds the military power of the Capital. The Emperor, using Ning Jiu’s cursed fate as a pretext, intends to use this marriage to kill Yan Yunzhou.
Yan Yunzhou is already critically ill due to recurring wounds suffered on the battlefield. The problem is, if the Prince dies, Ning Jiu is liable to be executed along with him. To survive, Ning Jiu resolves to cure Prince Yan’s illness. But this is ancient times—there are obviously no disinfectants, let alone antibiotics!
But who is he? Armed with a mentality of steel, Chief Ning has overcome countless hardships and adversities; his will cannot be broken this easily!
Can Ning Jiu, a doctor to his very core, succeed in saving Yan Yunzhou?
associated_names: 外科醫生的王府生存指南

190311.synopsis:
Melora, who works in the Research Division of the Kingdom’s Magic Order, is 24 years old and reaching the end of marriageable age. After breaking up with her ex-boyfriend, she bought her own house and has been thoroughly enjoying a carefree, single life with her two cats… until now.
When her boss introduces her to Arnold, a quiet younger man working as a civil service clerk, she finds herself drawn to his pitiable yet earnest nature, and the two get married.
The result? A life that is more comfortable than she ever could have imagined! He is way better than her ex, incredibly sweet, entirely devoted, a fantastic cook—and so innocent in bed!
Thus begins a cozy newlyweds’ life with her cute husband, who is two years her junior. (Note: However, the two of them drown in intense passion at night!)

One morning, the entire class wakes up trapped aboard a passenger airliner.
Among the more than thirty stunning female teachers and students on the plane, Yu Feng is the only man.
While everyone else is killing over a single drop of aviation fuel, Yu Feng awakens two extraordinary abilities: the Super Captain System and the Compensation for All Through Many Descendants talent.
Daily sign-ins grant attribute points, upgrading his aircraft unlocks premium lotteries, and interacting with the women allows him to awaken heaven-defying supernatural abilities.
